hero_desc: Building practical digital solutions across mobile and web platforms. I enjoy turning complex logic into clean code and creating scalable applications for both native Android and fullstack environments.
about_me_desc: A passionate software developer with practical experience in native Android and full-stack web environments. I focus on bridging complex requirements with clean, user-centric interfaces. Equipped with hands-on internship and project experience, I am constantly adapting and eager to build scalable digital solutions.
journey_paragraph_1: My journey in software development began when I entered the Information Technology Education program at Universitas Brawijaya. During my studies, I discovered a deep passion for building applications, which led me to join Bangkit Academy. Through that intensive program, I specialized in native Android development and was honored to graduate as one of the top students in the cohort.
journey_paragraph_2: To expand my technical skills further, I took on a full-stack developer internship at Kreasi Hexa Indonesia. Over the course of six months, I gained valuable experience building core features for an HRIS platform, handling everything from backend database logic to creating clean and responsive user interfaces.
journey_paragraph_3: I believe that technology is more than just lines of code; it is a way to provide meaningful solutions for users. I am now focused on refining my skills in building reliable mobile and web ecosystems, and I am always eager to contribute and grow within an innovative team.
frontend_desc: Crafting responsive and interactive interfaces using Vue, Tailwind CSS, and modern web standards.
android_desc: Building robust mobile applications with optimized performance and intuitive user experiences.
backend_desc: Managing data logic and APIs utilizing tools like Laravel, Supabase, and GitHub for version control.
hexa_task_1: Built a Human Resource Information System (HRIS) from scratch to digitalize internal workflows.
hexa_task_2: Architected a Single Page Application (SPA) using Laravel, Vue.js, and Inertia.js for seamless data flow.
hexa_task_3: Developed a contract management module featuring dynamic template generation and a secure, no-login e-signature system.
suarga_task_1: Developed backend mobile components in Kotlin for an ML-powered app aimed at preventing stunting.
suarga_task_2: Collaborated across Cloud Computing and Machine Learning cohorts to ensure reliable API integration and app logic.
suarga_task_3: Selected as one of the Top 50 Capstone Teams (out of 588) and awarded Best Presenter during the showcase.
bangkit_desc: Graduated with Distinction (Top 10%) with a final score of 94.09/100. Earned 7 professional certifications covering Kotlin, Android architecture, and SOLID principles.
ub_desc: Graduated on time with a very satisfactory predicate, achieving a GPA of 3.84/4.00. Built a strong theoretical foundation in software engineering while developing collaboration skills through committee roles in faculty-level events.
projects_subtitle: A collection of projects I've developed, ranging from mobile apps, full-stack web solutions, and more.
nontonapa_desc: A movie review web platform built with Laravel and Supabase. Enables users to browse movie catalogs, explore cast details, and share ratings and reviews interactively.
suarga_proj_desc: An Android native stunting prevention and monitoring app built with Kotlin. Integrates Machine Learning models for child nutrition risk assessment and daily dietary guidance.
story_app_desc: A native Android storytelling social app built with Kotlin. Features a public story feed, device camera integration for photo sharing, and interactive map location tagging.
kenali_oshimu_desc: A native Android directory app for JKT48 members built with Kotlin. Features comprehensive member profiles, jikoshoukai, social media intents, and profile sharing.
medease_desc: An integrated healthcare registration web platform built with Laravel and Bootstrap. Helps patients register at medical facilities online and manage appointments seamlessly.
learnbycode_desc: An intuitive UI/UX design and interactive prototype for a vocational student coding platform. Features structured learning paths, student-friendly visuals, and hands-on coding modules.
